decks.notes: This control deck focuses on utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures to dominate the game. By efficiently disrupting the opponent's game plan and overwhelming them with threats like Murktide Regent and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck aims to gradually gain control of the game and lock the opponent out of key plays. Additional support from cards like Archmage's Charm and Subtlety further enhances the deck's ability to control the pace of the game, allowing the player to dictate the flow of the match and emerge victorious.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently with cards like Amulet of Vigor, Simic Growth Chamber, and Primeval Titan. By utilizing the bounce lands and Amulet of Vigor, the deck can generate a large amount of mana in a single turn, allowing for explosive plays and the ability to quickly search out and play powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva. The deck also includes cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Cultivator Colossus to further enable its combo potential and increase its consistency in executing its game plan.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on using powerful creatures and disruption spells to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Ragavan, Tarmogoyf, and Wrenn and Six to quickly establish a strong board presence while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The deck also includes a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional value and flexibility. With a mix of efficient removal, hand disruption, and potent threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main strategy of this Modern 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly reduce your own life total to power up Death's Shadow and control the game with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. The deck aims to apply pressure with Death's Shadow, Murktide Regent, Grief, and Orcish Bowmasters while disrupting opponents with Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Counterspell. The inclusion of Persist and Undying Malice allows for recursion and value generation. By leveraging the Death's Shadow archetype, this deck aims to secure quick victories through a combination of fast creatures and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic to cast Living End from the graveyard, effectively mass reanimating a board full of powerful creatures to overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes various cycling creatures to help dig through the deck and find the necessary combo pieces, with disruption in the form of Force of Negation and Grief. The goal is to control the early game and then set up for a game-winning Living End in the mid to late game. The deck aims to be resilient against removal and disruption from the opponent while executing its combo.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. With access to plenty of colorless mana, the deck then controls the game using powerful artifacts and creatures like Karn Liberated, Wurmcoil Engine, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It also utilizes cards like Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings to find the necessary pieces to assemble the UrzaTron lands efficiently. The deck's goal is to outvalue and outlast opponents through its powerful control elements and mana advantage.

The deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to control the board. Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. Wrenn and Six provide additional recurring value, while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf serve as powerful threats. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Mishra's Research Desk allows for additional card advantage and ramp potential. The deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain tempo throughout the game to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements and powerful creatures to dominate the battlefield. It relies heavily on cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the pace of the game, while also using cards like Solitude and Leyline Binding to remove threats from the opponent. The key strategy is to establish control early on and then overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The deck also includes versatile cards like Prismatic Ending and Boseiju, Who Endures to adapt to different situations.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through aggressive creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while utilizing efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to control the opponent's board. Counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce provide protection for your threats, allowing you to maintain tempo and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Consider to ensure consistency and find the necessary pieces to close out the game.

This Modern UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Counterspell and interaction like Lightning Bolt. The deck's goal is to maintain tempo and pressuring the opponent's life total while controlling the board. The deck includes efficient card draw and selection engines like Expressive Iteration and Preordain to ensure a consistent flow of threats and answers. The mana base is streamlined for efficiency, allowing for early plays and minimizing mana inconsistencies.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly disrupt and control the opponent while applying constant pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck also focuses on card advantage and selection with Mishra's Bauble, Expressive Iteration, and Preordain, along with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. Counterspell and Force of Negation provide additional disruption to prevent the opponent from stabilizing. The deck aims to quickly end the game before the opponent can set up their own strategy.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells to quickly reduce their life total. It utilizes efficient removal spells and disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. The goal is to apply constant pressure and control the board to secure a quick victory.
